insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update is available as of September 9, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their order update logic to account for the new tax recalculation behavior. This change may affect existing order management workflows, especially those that involve shipping address changes. Developers should review their code to ensure compatibility with the updated orderUpdate mutation. The GraphQL Admin API is affected by this change, so developers using this API should take necessary actions to adapt to the new behavior.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when shipping addresses are updated for unfulfilled orders, which can help prevent tax-related issues and improve the overall customer experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax regulations, which is essential for merchants to avoid potential tax-related issues and penalties.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.
CLI version 4.6.1 has been released, which serves UI extension source maps during app development. This change improves the development experience for Shopify app developers.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexibility in cart management. The updateCart standard action updates cart attributes, and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event fires whenever an attributes update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed, consolidating how in-progress inventory holds are represented. This change may affect how inventory is tracked and managed.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search the catalog, manage the shopper's cart, and go to checkout on the shopper's behalf.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores. Note that development stores don't include public environments, so deployment URLs are not publicly accessible.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more flexibility in order management. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, with new thresholds that better reflect how fulfillment operations run in practice. This change makes Built for Shopify more achievable for fulfillment services apps.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts. Vue bindings are now available, allowing developers to build storefronts in Vue with the same Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and other related fields have been added.
CLI version 4.6.0 has been released, which removes deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching. Flags have also been added to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making when approving collaborator access. This change improves the collaborator access experience for merchants.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data, storefront events, and inventory management

themes.title: Performance Data and Analytics
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enables more informed decision-making for merchants.

themes.title: Storefront and Inventory Updates
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed. Additionally, WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.

themes.title: Development Tools and Updates
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This update improves the development experience for Shopify developers.
